description: Defines internal APIs, enums, callback types, and structures for handling AT commands in Bluetooth host subsystem.

methods.name: at_register
methods.description: Registers callback functions for AT response and finish events.

methods.name: at_register_unsolicited
methods.description: Registers callback for unsolicited AT responses.

methods.name: at_get_number
methods.description: Retrieves a number from the AT client.

methods.name: at_parse_input
methods.description: Parses input buffer for AT commands.

methods.name: at_parse_cmd_input
methods.description: Parses command input buffer with specific prefix and callback.

methods.name: at_check_byte
methods.description: Checks for a specific byte in the buffer.

methods.name: at_list_get_range
methods.description: Gets range values from the list.

methods.name: at_has_next_list
methods.description: Checks if more list items are available.
